text_block_list.text:
After our outing, as I walked back to the 
academy with Rice Shower—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... Onii-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want just a little more of your time 
today, big brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want just a little more of your time 
today, big sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to see together 
with you...!

She had a look of utter seriousness. I 
decided to grant her request.

Together with Rice Shower, I waited for 
nightfall and went up to the school 
rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Today is supposed to be the day we can see 
a meteor shower, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You know, when Rice heard about that, Rice 
knew she just had to see it together with 
Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You know, when Rice heard about that, Rice 
knew she just had to see it together with 
Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming with me, Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming with me, Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: There are... quite a few clouds today.

Looking up, there were indeed far more 
clouds than expected, making it difficult 
to get a clear view of the sky.

A brief worry crossed my mind that she 
might blame herself for this gloomy 
weather, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, you know what, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, you know what, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Until the clouds clear... Until the sky 
can be seen...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Could you wait with me just a little bit 
longer...?

—Seeing Rice Shower ask that, I realized 
my worries had been completely unfounded.
choice_data_list: I do want to make a wish, after all
I want to make a wish, don't I?

text_block_list.text:
—Seeing Rice Shower ask that, I realized 
my worries had been completely unfounded.
choice_data_list: I do want to make a wish, after all
I want to make a wish, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what? S-Stronger? Wh-What do you 
mean...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Did Rice say something weird...
choice_data_list: Because I was able to say I want to wait.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Yeah, you're right. I probably 
couldn't have said that a little while 
ago.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"The old Rice probably would've cried 
right away... But now... I won't cry."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because today, Rice thought she wanted to 
watch the shooting stars with you, Big 
Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because today, Rice thought she wanted to 
watch the shooting stars with you, Big 
Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because I truly, desperately wanted to do 
so.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah— Dear brother! The sky! Look at the 
sky!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah— Dear sister! The sky! Look at the sky!

Before we knew it, the clouds had 
vanished, and the night sky was filled 
with the brilliant shine of countless 
stars.

Amidst the engulfing flood of brilliant 
radiance, shooting stars fall one after 
another.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wah...! So many shooting stars...!
choice_data_list: It was worth the wait, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

That day became an unforgettable night for 
both Rice Shower and myself.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... You felt that way too, 
Onii-sama..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... You felt that way too, 
Onee-sama..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Big Brother, what are you going to wish 
for?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...What are you going to wish for, Big 
Sis?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fweh!? Rice's... cute spot!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-It took me by surprise, but... still—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's similar to what Rice wished for.
choice_data_list: What did you wish for, Rice Shower?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice's wish is... to be with everyone who 
supports Rice—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother's happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister's happiness.

—At that moment, something sparkled at the 
edge of my vision.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother, look! The sky is—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister, look! The sky is—

Before I knew it, the clouds had vanished 
from the sky, leaving it painted with 
twinkling stars and the brilliance of 
shooting stars.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wah...! So many shooting stars...!
choice_data_list: I have to make a wish!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

Together with Rice Shower, I entrusted my 
wish to the falling rain of stars.
